properties.name: apex.grpc.collector.allowed-responders
properties.description: Explicit nonempty unique allowlist with routes when collection selected.

properties.name: apex.grpc.security.peers
properties.description: Existing certificate policy grants; no OAuth/SSO SDK functionality added.

properties.name: apex.grpc.destinations
properties.description: At most 32 static routes; local or explicit Boot channel; discovery may supply routes.

properties.name: apex.grpc.max-deadline
properties.description: Maximum per-call deadline 1ms..30s; does not establish inherited parent budget propagation.

properties.name: apex.grpc.test-clients
properties.description: Explicit loopback test caller allowlist; never a production authorization fallback.
